key_insight: FEALPy.CFD is a high-performance, cross-platform solver for incompressible Navier-Stokes equations that maximizes hardware utilization across multiple computational backends.
engineering_relevance: It simplifies the development of computational fluid dynamics solutions, enabling efficient engineering applications and research.
method: Backend-agnostic design for seamless CPU/GPU switching.
Highly modular architecture with composable components for various discretization schemes.
Supports multiple computational backends including NumPy, PyTorch, and JAX.
evidence_signal: Numerical schemes validated on benchmark cases achieved their theoretical orders of convergence.
watch_item: Potential complexity in backend management may introduce overhead in performance tuning.
paper_title: A High-Performance, Cross-Platform Open-Source Solver for the Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations in FEALPy
